about: What scripts/pcb_check.py and factory_check.py hold this board to, besides the fab profile. 'nets' is the design intent from the README, written by hand: the schematic must match it exactly. 'approved' findings stay in the report with their reason and stop counting as problems; each one is a decision, not an oversight.

approved.match: POWER pin U1 V+ connected to +9V
approved.why: the 555's supply pin is named V+ and its net +9V: right connection, different names (owner, 2026-11-18)
M3 screw holes: plated is fine for a screw
the Tinkercad resistor and NE555 footprints draw 0.12 mm lines; they print faint, only a label. Our own library (backlog E3.5) fixes it
the same footprint lines, measured on the Gerber
the footprints' lead marks and outlines touch their pads (C1, R1, R2, R3); the fab trims silk at pads, nothing else is affected
the same marks seen on the Gerber at the resistor and C1 pads, trimmed by the fab
a through-hole kit, soldered by hand: no assembly is ordered
